info.background_text:
A cool-headed tactician.
The younger twin brother of Lucas. He can be rather curt and serious, but underneath his cold exterior is a kind and caring heart.Though he gives off the impression of being uninterested in others due to his stoic demeanor, he quietly pays attention to those around him and offers timely words of advice.
